text.title: Inference Cost Unit Economics Decision Tree
text.summary: Routing tree mapping observable signals in the cost data and draft report to a rule from 01-core-rules.xml for inference-cost-unit-economics.

decision-tree.root-question: Does the draft report compute cost per successful outcome from provider-reported usage, with prices pinned and the tail shown?

conclusion.verdict: SKIP: internal-only feature or attribution missing; track raw cost, fix call-to-feature attribution, do not compute unit economics yet
BLOCK: define the success metric per feature and recompute cost per successful outcome
BLOCK: log the provider usage object per call and recompute
BLOCK: split into input, output, retrieval, tools (plus cached tokens where billed separately)
BLOCK: pin provider, model id, sheet date and discount per price line
FLAG: name the retry cause and fix retry policy before any prompt or model change
BLOCK: state attributed revenue, allocation key or value proxy per feature
FLAG: report p50/p95/mean and name the tail driver
ACTION: set the ceiling from target margin, wire the spend alert, list features over ceiling with owner
PUBLISH: emit the report, record the price-sheet date, schedule the next refresh

text.example: support-agent feature: outcome = resolved ticket, usage logged per call, four cost lines, retry share 12%, p95 3.1x p50, margin 90% on attributed revenue, cost per outcome $0.42 under $0.60 ceiling → all_checks_pass → run-the-checklist.
